biography.plain_text: Anthony “Tony” Petrarca is an American property developer who founded Cedarwood Companies in Akron, Ohio, in 1972. Starting with his wife, Lenora, and one labourer, he built a business spanning development, architecture, construction and property management. Its projects range from apartments and shopping centres to offices, hotels and senior living communities.

long_biography.plain_text:
For property developer Tony Petrarca, designing accommodation for older people became personal. He wanted the care and amenities he would have chosen for his own father, who lived to 100. That ambition helped shape Melody Living, an assisted living and memory care community in Colorado Springs, where residents and staff participate in decisions about everyday care.

His wider business also combines development with continuing responsibility for completed buildings. Cedarwood has retained and managed many of the shopping centres it developed, while adapting its building programme as markets changed. A later emphasis on multifamily housing added residential communities to a portfolio that had expanded nationally through retail and hospitality projects.
